methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The idea is to build the model of preference of the Decision Maker and to establish a generic procedure about decision supported by a MCDA tool. Our proposition is to use the ACUTA method in order to elicit this model of preference.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper presents an MCDA/MAUT decision-aiding model (the ACUTA method) to build the Decision Maker's model of preference for choosing where to place energy-measurement instrumentation under ISO 50001. It contains no EnPI or EnB measurement-model content: no energy performance indicator or energy baseline is presented, proposed, evaluated, or critiqued (energy consumption data is only descriptive input to the instrumentation decision). Per Stage-1 rule, a framework/tool without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content is ineligible.

paper_type.evidence_quote: this paper is based on the case presently studied in the company adixen Vacuum Products (aVP)

stage1.notes: MCDA/MAUT (ACUTA) decision-aiding for instrumentation choice; no EnPI/EnB model built. Company aVP is a vacuum-technology manufacturer (discrete manufacturing/R&D/services), not a continuous-process sector; level_3b false regardless of eligibility.
